 HOBART, Australia (AP) — Ben Duckett and Sonny Baker played starring roles as England beat Australia by 97 runs to seal a 2-1 win in the one-day international cricket series on Wednesday.
 Duckett scored a century as the visitors racked up 328 all out in the third and final match in Hobart.
 Australia was then bowled out for 231, with pace bowler Baker taking four wickets and Liam Dawson picking up three.
 Victory for England came despite going 1-0 down earlier in the series . It bounced back by securing a 135-run win Sunday in Adelaide.
 “It wasn’t an ideal start to the series, notoriously we’ve been a bit slow getting into series, but the way we bounced back in Adelaide and the performance we put in today, the boys should be really proud,” England captain Harry Brook said.
 Duckett scored 133 off 115 balls at the Bellerive Oval on Wednesday after Brook had won the toss and decided to bat.
 Opening batter Duckett was finally out to a top edge, with Matt Renshaw taking his wicket. He looked to slog sweep to the short side of the ground but hit the ball straight up and Josh Inglis took the catch.
 Will Jacks added 59 for England while Jack Edwards claimed four wickets for Australia and Renshaw added three.
 Mahli Beardman, who took six wickets on debut in the first ODI, and Alex Carey came into Australia's side for Riley Meredith and Adam Zampa.
 Australia slumped to 5-2 in reply after losing Travis Head and Mitchell Marsh. It was then 34-3 when Inglis was caught by Jordan Cox off Baker.
 Renshaw top-scored with 55 before being caught and bowled by Dawson with the score on 108-4.
 When Duckett caught Spencer Johnson off Brook, England's victory was sealed.
 “Well played to England, they outplayed us, lots of areas for us to work on," Australia captain Marsh said. “While we haven’t won and we have been outplayed, I still have a lot of excitement about this group. It’s a good group of young lads, they’re on a journey and the World Cup is still 12 months away so it’s good to bring them in."
 The two teams start their T20 series in Melbourne on Saturday.
